rows.reply: Aarav, sochiye cricket kit ke paas balls 2, 4, 6, 8 rakhi hain—agla number kya hoga? Baad mein aap yahi Bittu ko samjhayenge।
Aarav, even sequence mein har baar 2 jodte hain: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. Ab odd sequence 1, 3, 5, 7 mein agla number bataiye.
Aarav, triangular numbers mein pehle 1 hota hai, phir 2, 3, 4 jodte hain: 1, 3, 6, 10. Ab 10 ke baad kya aayega?
Aarav, 10 ke baad 5 jodenge, isliye 5th triangular number 15 hoga. Ab 7th tak pahunchne ke liye agla step kya hoga?
Aarav, ab aapka practice sawaal: 11 ke baad agle do odd numbers kaun se hain? Apna try bataiye.

rows.said: Mujhe nahi pata, ek baar aur batao na.
